canonical_title: Night vision imaging system compatible lighting

versions.title_at_revision: Night vision imaging system compatible lighting
versions.text:
Standard: Interior lighting does not interfere with NVDs and does not impact the ability to maintain flight. Interior lighting does not cause glare, reflection, or halation that interferes with NVDs. Night vision imaging system lighting is compliant with MIL-STD-3009, Chromaticity Requirements table and NVIS Radiance Requirements Using English Units table. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
(1) Ground test: Night vision imaging system spectral radiance is tested IAW MIL-STD-3009, Spectral Radiance Limits section.
(2) Ground test: Night vision imaging system chromaticity is tested IAW MIL-STD-3009, Chromaticity Measurements section.
(3) Ground test: Night vision imaging system compatibility is tested IAW MIL-STD-3009, System Level Verification section.
